base={(0,0),(0,1),(1,2),(1,3),(2,2),(2,3),(3,2)}
def norm(s):
 a=min(x for x,y in s); b=min(y for x,y in s); return frozenset((x-a,y-b) for x,y in s)
shapes=set()
for ref in (0,1):
 for rot in range(4):
  z=set(base)
  if ref:z={(x,-y) for x,y in z}
  for _ in range(rot):z={(y,-x) for x,y in z}
  shapes.add(norm(z))
print('orientations',len(shapes))
placements=[]
for sh in shapes:
 mh=max(x for x,y in sh); mw=max(y for x,y in sh)
 for r in range(len(g)-mh):
  for c in range(len(g[0])-mw):
   if all(g[r+x][c+y]==0 for x,y in sh):
    placements.append((r,c,sh))
    for x,y in sh:g[r+x][c+y]=4
print('placements',len(placements),'new cells',sum(row.count(4) for row in g)-7)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in g))
